requirements.reason: C04-I has not created the directory and socket at ADR-0009 section 1's owner, group and modes
C04-I has not made a missing admin group a refusal to start
C04-I has not created a directory only the admin group may traverse
C04-I has not created a socket whose mode makes the kernel refuse an outsider
C04-I has not shown that no request byte is consumed before the authorization decision
C04-I has not made the denial record durable before the denial response
C04-I has not withheld a denial response it could not record
C04-I has not denied a stale-membership session in-band
C04-I has not denied root outside the admin group in-band
C04-I has not made every in-band denial the single authorization_denied frame
C04-I has not recorded exactly one audit record per in-band denial
C04-I has not shown a kernel refusal adds no audit record
C04-I has not recorded the SO_PEERCRED uid and a snapshot username with no pid, job or target
C04-I has not shown request fields cannot set the recorded actor
C04-I has not refused to start over a non-socket at the socket path
C04-I has not refused to start over a socket owned by another user
C04-I has not refused to start over a live socket
C04-I has not recovered a stale root-owned socket
C04-I has not refused to start when a non-root principal can write the socket directory
C04-I has not limited connections awaiting authorization
C04-I has not bounded authorization with a timeout that frees the slot
C04-I has not limited authorized connections
C04-I has not refused an oversized frame before allocating it
C04-I has not shown the listening server holds no IP socket
C04-I has not recorded an enabled fault point in the audit

ADR-0009 section 5: the kernel refusal and the in-band refusal must be indistinguishable to the CLI's caller. At the socket they differ by construction; only a CLI can make them the same, and C04 wires no verb (D-C04-4). C05's first verb is where a CLI exists to test
ADR-0009 section 5: either refusal path must exit 10. The exit-code mapping needs a verb to run, and C04 wires none (D-C04-4)
ADR-0009 section 5: ENOENT on the socket must exit 1, not 10. The exit-code mapping needs a verb to run, and C04 wires none (D-C04-4)
ADR-0009 section 9: in-flight requests per connection must be bounded. With no verb there is no request that can be in flight, so C04 cannot make the limit observable
